id.title: Id
id.description: A short name, unique in this file.

kind.title: Kind
kind.$comment: What the system is. The examples are the kinds the framework knows; another kind is kept, with a warning, so that a module can add one.

chain.title: Chain
chain.description: For an on-chain system: its chain, as CAIP-2 (eip155:42220 is Celo).
chain.$comment: CAIP-2, for on-chain kinds: eip155:42220 is Celo. With address it makes the CAIP-10 account: the address stays bare here.

chains.title: Chains
chains.description: For a Safe read on more than one chain: each of them, the first being its chain.
chains.$comment: CAIP-2 chains the same Safe is read on, for a Safe only; `chain` is the first of them. The address is the same on each chain.

address.title: Address
address.description: For an on-chain system: its address, bare. A Hats tree is its tree id.
address.$comment: For on-chain kinds, bare (CAIP-10 is `chain` + `address`). A Safe, a Gardens community or a Gardens pool is a 0x address; a Hats tree is its tree id, decimal or short hex.

url.title: Link
url.description: For an off-chain system: where it is.

space.title: Snapshot space
space.description: For a Snapshot space: its id, when the link does not say it.
space.$comment: For a snapshot-space: the space's id on the hub, when the url does not say it.

driver.title: Driver
driver.description: What reads it. Left empty, it is shown as a link.
driver.$comment: The platform driver that reads it; absent means a framed link.

section.title: Section
section.description: Where the Hub shows it, for example organization/treasury.
section.$comment: Where the platform shows it, for example organization/treasury.

embeddable.title: Embeddable
embeddable.description: Whether it can be shown inside the Hub.

description.title: Description
description.description: What the system is for, in a sentence.
description.$comment: What the system is for, in a sentence. Published as the grant pool's description when the system is one.

grant_pool.title: Grant pool
grant_pool.description: For a Gardens pool that funds: what to publish about it as a grant pool.
grant_pool.$comment: A Gardens pool that funds: false (or absent) says it is not published as a DAOIP-5 grant pool. An object publishes it, with what the read cannot know.

mechanism.description: One of DAOIP-5's funding mechanisms (copied; a test keeps this list equal to lib/standards/daoip5.mjs MECHANISMS).

relates.title: Relations
relates.description: Relations the map draws from this system that the chain does not give.
relates.$comment: Relations the DAO map draws from this System that the chain does not give (L4c E-38). `to` is a System id in this file, a system:<id>, or a hat ref; `label` the relation in plain words.

roles.title: Roles
roles.description: For a Hats tree: where each hat sits on the map, deciding or acting.
roles.$comment: For a hats-tree: where a hat sits on the DAO map, by its ref (eip155:<n>:0x<64 hex>): decides (who decides, layer 0) or acts (the roles that act, layer 1).

$comment: data/systems.yaml (F1 spec §3.4): one place for the org's outside systems and their addresses. Optional fields accept null.
